Enhanced Javelins.description: When a stormlord hurls a javelin, it functions as a +1 magical weapon. This enhancement improves to +2 at 6th level and +3 at 10th level.

Resistance to Electricity 5.description: As a stormlord advances in this prestige class, his body grows progressively more resistant to electrical energy, gaining electricity resistance as indicated by his class level. Upon reaching 9th level, the stormlord becomes completely immune to electricity.

Shock Weapon.description: At 2nd level and beyond, any spear or javelin wielded by a stormlord gains the shock property, inflicting an additional 1d6 points of electricity damage on a hit. This property fades 1 round after the weapon leaves the stormlord's grasp.

Shocking Burst Weapon.description: From 8th level onward, any spear or javelin wielded by a stormlord gains the shocking burst property. This property fades 1 round after the weapon leaves the stormlord's grasp. This benefit stacks with the stormlord's thundering weapon ability. Storm of Elemental Fury (Sp): Upon reaching 10th level, the stormlord can call forth a devastating storm of tremendous force. Once per day, the stormlord may invoke storm of elemental fury, functioning as though cast by a 17th-level cleric.

Spells per Day/Spells Known.description: Each time the stormlord gains a class level, he receives new spells per day (and spells known, if relevant) as though he had also gained a level in a divine spellcasting class he belonged to before entering this prestige class. He does not, however, receive any other benefits that class would normally grant (such as improved turning ability, additional favored enemies, or similar features). If the character had multiple divine spellcasting classes prior to becoming a stormlord, he must choose which class receives the benefit of each new stormlord level for determining spells per day and spells known.

Storm Ride.description: At 6th level, the stormlord gains the capacity to fly whenever a storm is present, as though under the effect of a fly spell. Hostile wind conditions have no impact on him while airborne; even winds of hurricane strength cannot knock him from the sky or blow him off course.

Storm Walk.description: From 3rd level onward, the stormlord (along with his mount, if applicable) can travel on foot or mounted through any storm, whether natural or magical, at his normal movement rate. He remains entirely unhindered by powerful winds (including gust of wind effects), driving rain or waves, airborne debris carried by the wind (which invariably misses him), deafening thunder, natural lightning strikes, or any other storm-related hazard.

Thundering Weapon.description: At 5th level and higher, any spear or javelin used by the stormlord gains the thundering property. This property fades 1 round after the weapon leaves the stormlord's grasp. This benefit stacks with the stormlord's shock weapon ability.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: The stormlord does not gain any additional weapon or armor proficiencies.
